propositions: transport.py has reached 799 LOC (800-line cap) and blocks further parent-related work; prior reactive splits along nearest seams (retry.py, transitions.py) did not establish natural module boundaries, causing new code to accumulate back in the god file.

The module's structure is organized by nothing; the class already satisfies capability Protocols (_backend.py: TicketTransport, SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsAbsenceProbe) that should be the natural split boundaries but are not used to determine file layout.

JiraDataCenterTransport can be mechanically re-architected as a thin composition root mixing in capability-cohesive modules (_base, _issues, _hierarchy, _links, _people) without altering behavior, Protocol conformance, call shapes, or test assertions—enabling every future operation to find its determined home by answering 'which capability is this?'

The relocation prevents reintroduction of _resolve_epic_link_field_id duplication (which 9bb9 deliberately avoided) by extracting it exactly once in _hierarchy.py and documenting the organising principle in the package docstring so the next operation has a determined home.

All resulting modules are between 100–500 LOC; none exceeds the 800-line cap, and transport.py reduces from 799 to 230 lines, unblocking subsequent parent work that was operator-approved to land after this mechanical split.
